filtering_rules: Use the published GeoNames cities15000.zip populated-place dump. Keep feature class P. Keep country codes for Ireland, the United Kingdom (GB), the EU-27 and the other EEA states (IS, LI, NO). Drop short rows, non-numeric ids, blank names and exact duplicate geoname ids. Value is the place name, a comma, the country code. cities500.zip is used only if cities15000.zip yields fewer than 200 rows. No subjective removal.
